name: SOL intraday breakout/retest and failed-bounce

execution.protective_order_submission: Explicit wallet approval; native triggers then execute without another popup

conditions: Retest holds and turns upward; manual confirmation required
Retest low must allow a structural stop at 118.60
long.skip_if: No retest or price reaches 119.80–120 before entry

conditions: Price tests 119.00–119.20 and fails to sustain it
A later rebound to 118.65–118.80 stalls and turns down; manual confirmation required
Rejection high must allow a structural stop at 119.30
short.skip_if: Price reaches 117.90–118 without the failed rebound entry

blockers: Chart levels need fresh market validation; they are not live signals
Fees and an execution allowance must fit within the $5 planned loss budget
Configured 200 bps slippage is wider than the approximately 50 bps stop distance
Native protection tools require verification against the connected wallet and live API before a strategy is armed
Long USDC-to-SOL conversion remains blocked until its transaction route is validated
Short entries require the returned native transaction to include all three exact-third targets and the full stop; current API compatibility is not established
no_entry_when: Choppy movement without a completed setup
Price reaches targets before the entry develops
notes: Targets split the original position equally; rewards are not additive
Stops cannot guarantee a maximum realized loss
No measured win rate or validated edge is claimed
No actual order is created from the reference entry levels
